'''Sedret Fain''' was a [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who crashed a meeting between [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] diplomat [[Thel Erelen]] and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] executives, including [[Serrol Gathip]], at the [[Duro Starshipwright Shipyards|Duro Delta 12]] shipyards in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
